English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #misleading#BarakObama Did Barack Obama secretly come to Sri Lanka? Misleading Factseeker observed that a photo is being shared on social media that states that former American President Barack Obama visited Sri Lanka. by Anonymous | December 31, 2023 Factseeker observed that a photo is being shared on social media that states that former American President Barack Obama visited Sri Lanka. The photograph shows Mr. Barack Obama drinking a tender coconut from a stall near the road. At first glance, the background of the photo looks similar to the Sri Lankan environment. Factseeker observed that a photo is being shared on social media that states that former American President Barack Obama visited Sri Lanka. The photograph shows Mr. Barack Obama drinking a tender coconut from a stall near the road. At first glance, the background of the photo looks similar to the Sri Lankan environment. Delivered to You. We are an independent fact-checking team affiliated with the Sri Lanka Press Institute(SLPI). The objective and long-term goal of the FactSeeker is to provide the public with reliable and verified content in the attempt of debunking mis/disinformation. The unit, with the SLPI, is committed to contributing to improved media literacy in Sri Lanka.
